comments.text: You took a bike that isn't yours and brought it back broken. Pay for the repair.
It's a flat tire. Your roommate borrows your stuff all the time, so this is not a big deal.
You should have asked first, but yelling at you over a flat is too much.
Sure, borrowing without asking is fine, as long as it comes back in one piece. Oh wait.
Patch kits cost five dollars. Keep one in your bag.
Did you two agree to share things? If so, I don't see the problem.
